description: Athletics age groups of World Athletics (U18, U20, Senior, Master) with their reference-date rule, the O2SN 2026 eligibility groups (birth date limit, grades) for SD/MI, SMP/MTs and SMA/MA/SMK/MAK, POPDA Jawa Tengah 2026 (born in 2008 or later) and the POPNAS rule (at most 18, secondary); championships keep their own reference rule.
status: partial: PASI publishes no U14/U16 age rule (www.pbpasi.org searched 2026-11-28); POPNAS birth-date limit per edition not published on a reachable official site (brief R-10b)
source: World Athletics Book C C1.1/C2.1 Competition & Technical Rules (amendments effective up to 2026-03-20, PDF 2026-07-17); IAAF Scoring Tables for Combined Events (2016); Puspresnas O2SN 2026 guides SD/MI, SMP/MTs, SMA/MA/SMK/MAK (March 2026) and the O2SN scoring tables they link to (Trilomba SMP, Pancalomba SMA/SMK; fetched 2026-11-26); Dispora Jawa Tengah, Juknis POPDA Tingkat Provinsi Jawa Tengah 2026 (letter 400.3.9.2/371/2026 of 27 February 2026, scanned; fetched 2026-11-27); Kemenpora Laporan Kinerja 2025 Sesdep 3 quoting the POPNAS age rule of Peraturan Ketua Umum PP BAPOPSI 8/2022 (fetched 2026-11-27). Raw PDFs and SOURCE.txt in sources/atletik/, sources/atletik/o2sn/, sources/atletik/popda-jateng/ and sources/atletik/popnas/; PB PASI result books of Kejurnas Atletik U16 & Indonesia U18 Open 2024 (Yogyakarta) and LPS Kejurnas Atletik & U18 Indonesian Athletics Open 2025 (Surakarta), www.pbpasi.org (searched and fetched 2026-11-28 WIB; not kept, URL and SHA-256 in sources/atletik/pasi-kejurnas/SOURCE.txt)
licence: Copyright World Athletics (rules, tables); Kemendikdasmen (O2SN guides), Pemerintah Provinsi Jawa Tengah (POPDA juknis) and Kemenpora (report) are public government documents; facts with references used under decision F-027; PASI result books are public results of the federation (facts with references)
procedure: Transcribed by hand into tools/converters/atletik.py, which checks the scoring parameters against printed table rows (with --tables: every row of the two O2SN tables, 17,595 rows) and the tables for completeness, then writes the three sets. The POPDA juknis is scanned: its facts were read on the page images, with PDF pages in `ref`. The PASI Kejurnas programmes come from the result books' event headings (sources/atletik/pasi-kejurnas/event-headings.txt; the converter checks the count). Version 2026-11-28 is the date PASI's site was searched, the newest source.
